name: Persuade
effect: Attempt to change another agent's decision through reasoning, evidence or incentives.

name: Threaten
effect: Attempt to force another agent's behaviour by communicating credible consequences.

name: Deceive
effect: Attempt to make another agent believe something that is false or incomplete.

name: Reassure
effect: Attempt to calm another agent or strengthen their willingness to cooperate.

name: Recruit
effect: Attempt to convince another agent to support or join a cause.
